newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa slides through support, coffee firm AM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa slides through support, coffee firm AM.

text.p: COCOA - Opens lower as expected, Sept slides through 1,100 stg support. Recovers slightly from lows. Sept down 36 at 1,073 stg.
COFFEE - Very slow start, all positions at highs in thin dealings. Sept up $10 at $1,850 at 0854 GMT.
SUGAR - Tightly mixed but activity minimal. August up 20 cents at $319.20.
